items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: She was a princess, an Indian princess. And her father sent her to Kansas City to school.

ctx.x: What tribe was your grandfather from?

Creek. And oddly, I never heard my uncles or aunts ever speak of their grandfather, you know? And here in the last year, I've been trying to trace my family tree. And one of my cousins come up with my great-grandmother on the Simmons side -- I forget what her name was. I was told, but I've forgotten. She was a princess, an Indian princess. And her father sent her to Kansas City to school. And around about that time, a gentleman of your paint job European had a covered wagon. He was headed West. And he saw this…
Was the man in the covered wagon Simmons?
